_readme: Manually-maintained Four Capabilities Watch observations and pending-capability notes. Each observation is a raw candidate consumed by manual-capabilities-adapter.js and normalized by domain/capabilities/observation.js — same shape as CapabilitySourcePort candidates. goal_autonomy levels 2-4 and any high-risk-phrase content are routed to review regardless of what reviewStatus is set here (see domain/capabilities/policies.js reviewRequired). Do not hand-edit reviewStatus to 'approved' for anything you have not personally verified against the cited source_url.

observations.notes: Top of the current leaderboard, average across 5 runs, $500 starting balance, ~1-year (365-day) simulated business run. A simulated bank balance, not real income — the agent never left the simulation, took no real-world financial action, and the human ceiling for the same task is materially higher (~$63k per Andon Labs commentary), so this is a controlled-benchmark result, not evidence of independent real-world resource acquisition.
observations._instructions: Re-check https://andonlabs.com/evals/vending-bench-2 quarterly (page is client-rendered; use a real browser, not a plain HTTP fetch — the leaderboard table doesn't appear in the static HTML). Update value/model/observedAt on a new leaderboard leader. Never change unit to USD_real or environment to real_world for this benchmark.

ai_improvement._instructions: Look up a specific, dated frontier-model result on METR's RE-Bench (github.com/METR/RE-Bench, compares agents against 71 human ML-research-engineering attempts) or PostTrainBench. Do not use forecasted/predicted scores (e.g. trend-fit projections) — only an actually-measured, published result with a named model and date qualifies. Add as an observation with capability: 'ai_improvement', metric naming the benchmark, and extra.improvedAnotherModel / extra.wasDeployed / extra.improvementCycleFollowed set from the source, not assumed.

goal_autonomy._instructions: This capability is intentionally unpopulated until a specific, dated piece of evidence (a system card, Apollo Research report, or similar) is reviewed by Vaughan and assigned a goal_autonomy_level per the domain/capabilities value-objects ladder (0-4). Levels 2-4 require review before publication regardless of source confidence — see policies.js. Do not infer a level from general reputation or secondhand summary; cite the exact supporting excerpt.
